# Inventory business-metric evaluation (auto-generated by inventory_business_metrics.py)

Primary series FOODS_2_197_CA_4_evaluation, TEST period 1553-1941 (388 days), lead time 2, greedy policies from the initial stock (on-hand = ceil(2u), empty pipeline). Profit is in the M5 price currency (USD) for this ONE item; costs are my assumptions (unit cost 0.6 x price, holding 0.5% of unit cost, stockout penalty 0.2 x price, fixed order cost 0.5 x unit cost). fill_rate = units sold / units demanded; stockout_rate = share of days with lost sales; service_level = 1 - stockout_rate; avg_inventory = mean end-of-day on-hand units. J_true_ope = Monte Carlo value (eps_t=0.1, 24 rollouts per start day).

## Window-bootstrap 95% CIs (resampling the 300 OPE windows of the ground truth; 500 draws per repetition, pooled over 10 repetitions)
